content: मनन {%a.%} [मन्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा] Thoughtful, careful. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Thinking, reflection, meditation, cogitation; युक्त्या संभावितत्वानुसंधानं मननं तु तत् <ls>Pañchadaśī 1. 53</ls>; मननान्मुनिरेवासि <ls>Hariv.</ls> .²2 Intelligence, understanding. .²3 An inference arrived at by reasoning. .²4 A guess, conjecture.
